Deploys mods as APFS clones: no extra di: Deploys mods as APFS clones: no extra disk space, and edits to deployed files leave your staging folder untouched.
APFS clones share their data with the or:
APFS clones share their data with the original file until one of them is modified.
Advantages:
 - no extra disk space, like hard links
 - a tool that edits a deployed file (xEdit, BethINI) does not change the file in the staging folder
Disadvantages:
 - macOS only, mods have to be on the same APFS volume as the game
 - deploying is a little slower than with hard links
APFS clones are only available on macOS.
